S0432.reason: Extra-territorial abduction generally does not stay proceedings; courts may decline to stay to avoid frustrating justice, per jurisprudence suggesting stay would impede trying international criminals.

S0598.reason: Under the Vienna Convention a reservation incompatible with the object and purpose of the treaty is invalid, the classic ground under Article 19(c).

S0272.reason: SDS denatures proteins and imparts uniform negative charge, so separation depends on primary sequence length rather than charge or tertiary structure.
